test-set.name: ft-Examples2.3
test-set.description: XQuery Full Text - Section 2.3 - Examples Section 2.3

test-case.name: examples-23-q1
test-case.description: Return scores for books whose content contains "web site" and "usability" and whose title contains "testing"

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test examples-23-q1

test-case.test: (: 2.3 Scoring: Example 1. Expect 2 scores :) declare variable $input-context external; for $b score $s in $input-context/books/book[content contains text "web site" ftand "usability" and .//chapter/title contains text "testing"] return $s

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)

test-case.name: examples-23-q2
test-case.description: Return titles and scores for books whose content contains "web site" and "usability" where the score is more than 0.5

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test examples-23-q2

test-case.test: (: 2.3 Scoring: Example 2. Exact results depend on scoring. :) declare variable $input-context external; for $b score $s in $input-context/books/book[content contains text "web site" ftand "usability"] where $s > 0.5 order by $s descending return <result> <title> {$b//title} </title> <score> {$s} </score> </result>

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)

test-case.name: examples-23-q5
test-case.description: Return books whose chapter title contains "testing", ordered by the score of their content containing "web site" and "usability"

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test examples-23-q5

test-case.test: (: 2.3 Scoring: Example 5. Exact results depend on scoring. :) declare variable $input-context external; for $b in $input-context/books/book[.//chapter/title contains text "testing"] let score $s := $b/content contains text "web site" ftand "usability" order by $s descending return <result score="{$s}">{$b}</result>

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
